infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: GLIMMS uses the camera to photograph your clothes and items so the AI can create outfit ideas for you.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: GLIMMS does not record audio. This permission is only listed because the camera API requires it.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: GLIMMS uses your photo library so you can add existing photos of your clothes and items.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: GLIMMS saves design mockups to your photo library when you choose to export them.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: GLIMMS uses your approximate location to tailor style suggestions to your local weather and climate.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Allow GLIMMS to use Face ID to keep your session secure.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow GLIMMS to access your camera to photograph your clothes and items.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow GLIMMS to access the microphone. Audio is never recorded.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow GLIMMS to access your photos so you can add items to your closet.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow GLIMMS to access your camera to photograph your items.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow GLIMMS to use your location for climate-aware style recommendations.
